Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Cases Pending before the Appellate Trial Office, etc.)
(1) The Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office shall compile the trial documents, appellate trial documents, and immediate-appeal documents concerning cases prescribed in Article 2 (2) of the respective Addenda to the Act Partially Amending the Patent Act, Act No. 4892; the Act Partially Amending the Utility Model Act, Act No. 4893; the Act Partially Amending the Design Act, Act No. 4894; and the Act Partially Amending the Trademark Act, Act No. 4895 (hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Patent Act, etc."), and shall forward them to the President of the Patent Court within 30 days from the date these Rules enter into force. Documents received after the transfer shall be forwarded without delay.
(2) Where an applicant for an appellate trial, etc. has paid in full the fees prescribed by the Rules on Collection of Patent Fees, Registration Fees and Other Fees under the Patent Act, Utility Model Act, Design Act and Trademark Act to the Korean Intellectual Property Office, the applicant shall be deemed to have paid the revenue stamps to be affixed to the complaint, etc. filed with the Patent Court and the service fees. In such cases, the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office shall be the person responsible for paying service fees to the Patent Court, and shall attach one copy of the service-fee payment certificate prescribed by the Rules on Service Fees to the petition for appellate trial, etc. when transferring the documents under paragraph (1). [Amended on June 28, 2002.]
(3) Where an applicant for an appellate trial, etc. has failed to pay all or part of the fees, the following shall apply:
1. Where no fees were paid to the Korean Intellectual Property Office, the applicant shall pay the amount of revenue stamps and service fees to the Patent Court; where fees paid to the Korean Intellectual Property Office are less than the amount of revenue stamps, the applicant shall pay the shortfall in revenue stamps and the service fees to the Patent Court.
2. In cases under subparagraph 1 and where an applicant for an appellate trial, etc. paid only fees equivalent to the amount of revenue stamps, the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office shall pay service fees for two rounds of service to the Patent Court when transferring documents under paragraph (1).
3. Where fees paid to the Korean Intellectual Property Office exceed the amount of revenue stamps, the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office shall, when transferring documents under paragraph (1), pay the excess to the Patent Court as service fees. In such cases, the balance of service fees shall be returned to the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office, and where service fees are insufficient, the applicant for the appellate trial, etc. shall make an additional payment.
(4) In cases under paragraph (3), a petition for an appellate trial or immediate appeal shall be deemed a complaint; a petition for retrial shall be deemed a complaint for retrial; and an application for participation as a party in an appellate trial shall be deemed an application for intervention as a party at the first instance.
(5) Where a trial decision or a decision dismissing a petition for trial is served after these Rules enter into force and no objection has been lodged before the Appellate Trial Office, an action may be instituted in the Patent Court within 30 days from the date on which the trial decision or dismissal decision was served.
(6) Arguments and evidence presented before the Appellate Trial Office shall be presented anew at the hearing in the Patent Court.
